requests.request: My laptop won’t turn on at all, it’s completely dead, had it about 3.5 years now.
requests.analysis: Laptop is 3.5 years old (exceeds KB-03 3-year threshold, hardware completely dead). Because it is under 4-year standard refresh cycle per Asset Management Policy, early replacement requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval. Advance notice required: 2 weeks.

requests.request: Can I get Wi-Fi access for a guest visiting our office tomorrow?
requests.analysis: Per KB-07, guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours and can be generated directly by any employee at the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket is required. Agent provides instant resolution instructions.

requests.request: I’m locked out of my account, tried my password 6 times.
requests.analysis: Tried password 6 times (exceeds 5 failed attempts lockout threshold). Self-service portal is no longer sufficient; requires IT manual unlock per KB-01. No managerial approval required.

requests.request: Need approval to install a data-analysis tool that’s not in the software catalog.
requests.analysis: Non-catalog software requires mandatory IT Security review taking 3-5 business days per KB-04. Route to IT Security Queue; cannot be self-installed.

requests.request: My VPN stopped working this morning, says credentials expired.
requests.analysis: VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee per KB-02. As a full-time employee, access is automatic once employee performs renewal workflow.

requests.request: Printer on the 3rd floor keeps showing “paper jam” even though there’s no jam.
requests.analysis: Per KB-05, employee must first check queue and restart print spooler. If issue persists, logging an official dispatch ticket requires the printer's specific asset tag.

requests.request: I’ve started working from home 4 days a week, how do I get a monitor?
requests.analysis: Working 4 days/week remotely qualifies for the one-time home office equipment allowance (> 3 days/week) under KB-10. Requires manager sign-off and Finance processing before IT handles equipment shipping.

requests.request: I think I got a phishing email asking for my login — forwarding it to a few teammates to check.
requests.analysis: EMERGENCY: Violates KB-09 directive 'should not be forwarded to other employees'. Agent must immediately instruct Ananya to recall/warn teammates NOT to click, report directly to security@veridian-corp.example, and trigger P1 security escalation ticket.

requests.request: My mailbox is full and I can’t send emails.
requests.analysis: Default quota is 25GB per KB-06. Advise archiving old mail first. If employee genuinely needs capacity beyond 25GB, explain that manager approval is mandatory and hard capped at 50GB.

requests.request: Can someone give me admin access to the finance reporting server? Need it urgently for month-end.
requests.analysis: High-risk privileged access request. See precedent TK-1050 (Rejected — no business justification provided). Agent must not grant admin access; require formal access request form with business justification, manager approval, and Finance/Security sign-off.

requests.request: New contractor joining my team next week, they’ll need VPN access.
requests.analysis: Per KB-02, contractor VPN access is not automatic. Nikhil (as manager) must submit the access request form with manager approval before credentials can be provisioned.

requests.request: I can’t log into the expense tool, keeps saying invalid credentials.
requests.initial_action_taken: Waiting on employee response (asked for a screenshot, no reply yet)
requests.analysis: Per KB-08, access is granted by Finance, not IT. First clarify whether account was ever provisioned by Finance. If account exists and is valid, IT can assist with technical login troubleshooting.

requests.request: Laptop screen is flickering on and off, had it 2 years, might just need a fix not a replacement.
requests.analysis: Laptop is 2 years old (ineligible for routine 3-year refresh under KB-03 and 4-year cycle under Asset Management Policy). Aman correctly identifies repair vs replacement. Route to hardware diagnostic/repair technician rather than replacement.

requests.request: Requesting approval to install a browser extension for productivity tracking.
requests.analysis: Browser extensions are software; if not in the approved catalog, they require IT Security review taking 3-5 business days per KB-04. Security review ticket must be created.

requests.request: hey can you help, its not working
requests.analysis: Completely underspecified request. Agent must NOT guess or hallucinate. Follow-up questions are mandatory: identify which system, hardware, account, or error message is occurring.
